overview: BrainByte is a modern, responsive quiz web app with a dark theme. Players log in with a username, choose from 15 themed quiz categories across Tech, Fun, and Smart themes, set difficulty and question count, then compete on a local leaderboard.
features: Login with username stored in localStorage
15 quiz themes across Tech, Fun, and Smart categories
Adjustable difficulty levels and question count slider
Circular countdown timer with color progression
Score, percentage, and performance rating on results screen
Local top-10 leaderboard with time tracking
Smooth page transitions and hover animations
Fully responsive mobile and desktop layout
